slots.slot_label: About / Main heading: About Devil n Dove
About / Text after About Devil n Dove
slots.source_snapshot: Devil n Dove is our workshop, our creative outlet, and our way of keeping life moving—especially on the days that don’t cooperate. We’re not chasing perfection. We’re chasing progress, curiosity, and the kind of making that feels like breathing again.

slots.slot_label: About / Heading: What we do
About / Heading: Why we do it
About / Text after Why we do it
slots.source_snapshot: Making is therapy here. It’s structure, focus, and a reason to show up. We work around real limitations—and we share that honestly—because it’s part of the story and part of the strength.

slots.slot_label: About / Heading: What you’ll find on this site
slots.source_snapshot: What you’ll find on this site

slots.slot_label: About / Heading: Sourcing, provenance, and condition
About / Text after Sourcing, provenance, and condition
slots.source_snapshot: Devil n Dove is not only handmade work. We also sell vintage pieces, oddities, old tools, collectibles, and pre-built items. When something is not workshop-made, we want that stated plainly with sourcing notes, condition summaries, era clues, and outside-listing links where needed.

slots.slot_label: About / Heading: How sales channels work
About / Text after How sales channels work
slots.source_snapshot: Some items are sold directly on Devil n Dove, some are listed both here and elsewhere, and some are external-only listings. We keep that visible so buyers understand whether they are purchasing a workshop-made piece, reserving a collectible, or following a link out to another marketplace.

slots.slot_label: About / Heading: Snapshots from the bench
About / Text after Snapshots from the bench
slots.source_snapshot: The real stuff: tools, in-progress chaos, and the pieces that make it out the other side.

Coin & Spoon Ring Care / Main heading: Coin and spoon ring care
Coin & Spoon Ring Care / Text after Coin and spoon ring care
slots.source_snapshot: Repurposed-metal rings can carry texture, pattern, age, and character that mass-produced jewelry does not. Their care should match the actual metal, finish, sizing, and condition of the piece.

slots.slot_label: Coin & Spoon Ring Care / Heading: Before wearing
Coin & Spoon Ring Care / Text after Before wearing
slots.source_snapshot: Check the listing for material and size. Do not assume every patterned ring is sterling silver: some pieces are stainless steel, plated, mixed-metal, or of unknown composition. If you have a metal sensitivity, ask before purchase.

slots.slot_label: Coin & Spoon Ring Care / Heading: Fit and adjustment
Coin & Spoon Ring Care / Text after Fit and adjustment
slots.source_snapshot: Rings should not be forced over a knuckle or squeezed repeatedly. Repeated bending can stress some designs, patterns, solder points, or older metal. Contact us before using a ring stretcher, reducer, or pliers on a handmade or repurposed ring.

slots.slot_label: Coin & Spoon Ring Care / Heading: Cleaning and storage
Coin & Spoon Ring Care / Text after Cleaning and storage
slots.source_snapshot: Use a soft dry cloth first. Store rings separately from abrasive tools and loose hardware. If a piece has a special patina, darkened detail, stone, resin, or plated finish, ask before using a polish or chemical cleaner.

slots.slot_label: Coin & Spoon Ring Care / Heading: Gift note
Coin & Spoon Ring Care / Text after Gift note
slots.source_snapshot: A ring size, material note, and care card make a gift easier to enjoy. For custom or themed ring work, confirm sizing and timing before payment or engraving begins.

slots.slot_label: Coin & Spoon Ring Care / Heading: When in doubt, ask first
Coin & Spoon Ring Care / Text after When in doubt, ask first
slots.source_snapshot: If a listing has a special finish, a vintage condition detail, a custom sizing question, or product-specific safety notes, the individual listing and direct message take priority over this general guide.

slots.source_snapshot: Polymer clay earrings are lightweight and practical for everyday wear, but like other handmade jewelry they benefit from gentle handling and sensible storage.

slots.slot_label: Polymer Clay Earring Care / Heading: Wear and storage
Polymer Clay Earring Care / Text after Wear and storage
slots.source_snapshot: Put earrings on after hair spray, perfume, lotions, and makeup have had time to settle. Store pairs where they are not pressed under heavy metal pieces, sharp edges, or loose tools that can scratch the surface.

slots.slot_label: Polymer Clay Earring Care / Heading: Cleaning
Polymer Clay Earring Care / Text after Cleaning
slots.source_snapshot: Start with a soft dry cloth. If the listing permits it, a barely damp soft cloth may be used for a small surface mark, then dry the piece right away. Do not soak handmade earrings or use harsh household cleaners unless the product-specific care note says it is safe.

slots.slot_label: Polymer Clay Earring Care / Heading: Handmade variation
Polymer Clay Earring Care / Text after Handmade variation
slots.source_snapshot: Small differences in pattern, marbling, texture, placement, or finish are normal in handmade work. We describe obvious variation and use close-up photos where possible so the piece a buyer receives is clear.

slots.slot_label: Polymer Clay Earring Care / Heading: When to contact us
Polymer Clay Earring Care / Text after When to contact us
slots.source_snapshot: Contact us before trying a repair, glue, solvent, polish, or strong cleaner. A metal finding, resin accent, paint, or sealant can change the right care method for one specific piece.

slots.source_snapshot: How Devil n Dove collects, uses, protects, and handles website, order, media, and social-platform information.

slots.slot_label: Privacy Policy / Heading: Information we collect
Privacy Policy / Text after Information we collect
slots.source_snapshot: We collect information people choose to provide when they create an account, place an order, request a custom item, contact us, join a waitlist, submit media, or connect a social account. This can include names, contact details, shipping or pickup details, order information, account identifiers, and messages.

slots.slot_label: Privacy Policy / Heading: Website and device information
Privacy Policy / Text after Website and device information
slots.source_snapshot: Our hosting, security, analytics, and commerce services may process IP address, browser type, device information, pages visited, referral information, timestamps, cookies, and security events. We use this information to operate the site, prevent abuse, understand performance, and improve products and content.

slots.slot_label: Privacy Policy / Heading: Social-platform connections
Privacy Policy / Text after Social-platform connections
slots.source_snapshot: When an administrator connects Facebook, Instagram, Pinterest, X, TikTok, or YouTube, the platform may provide account identifiers, granted permissions, access and refresh tokens, token-expiry information, Page or channel identifiers, and publishing results. We use those details only to provide the requested connection, draft, publishing, and reporting features.

slots.slot_label: Privacy Policy / Heading: How we use information
Privacy Policy / Heading: Sharing and service providers
Privacy Policy / Text after Sharing and service providers
slots.source_snapshot: Information may be processed by services that help us host the website, store data and media, process payments, deliver messages, analyze performance, or connect social platforms. We disclose only what is reasonably needed for the service. We may also disclose information when legally required or to protect people, property, and the integrity of the service.

slots.slot_label: Privacy Policy / Heading: Retention and security
Privacy Policy / Text after Retention and security
slots.source_snapshot: We retain information only as long as reasonably needed for the purpose collected, legal obligations, dispute handling, security, and business records. Social tokens should be encrypted and revoked when disconnected. No system can promise absolute security, but we use access controls, encrypted secrets, audit logs, and least-privilege design.

slots.slot_label: Privacy Policy / Heading: Your choices
Privacy Policy / Text after Your choices
slots.source_snapshot: You may ask to access, correct, or delete eligible personal information, withdraw consent where applicable, or disconnect a social-platform connection. Some transaction and security records may need to be retained. See our Data Deletion Instructions .

slots.slot_label: Terms of Use & Sale / Main heading: Terms of Use and Sale
Terms of Use & Sale / Text after Terms of Use and Sale
slots.source_snapshot: Terms for using Devil n Dove, ordering handmade or vintage products, custom requests, media, and social publishing.

slots.slot_label: Terms of Use & Sale / Heading: Using the site
Terms of Use & Sale / Text after Using the site
slots.source_snapshot: You may browse the site and use its features for lawful personal or business interactions with Devil n Dove. Do not attempt to interfere with the service, bypass access controls, upload harmful material, impersonate another person, or use the site for fraud or spam.

slots.slot_label: Terms of Use & Sale / Heading: Products and workshop work
Terms of Use & Sale / Text after Products and workshop work
slots.source_snapshot: Many items are handmade, experimental, vintage, collectible, one-of-a-kind, or produced in small batches. Natural variation, tool marks, patina, and differences from photographs may occur. Product pages should identify known materials, condition, origin, dimensions, limitations, and availability as accurately as reasonably possible.

slots.slot_label: Terms of Use & Sale / Heading: Orders, pricing, and tax
Terms of Use & Sale / Text after Orders, pricing, and tax
slots.source_snapshot: Prices are shown in the currency identified at checkout and may change before an order is accepted. Applicable taxes, shipping, delivery, or pickup terms are shown during checkout or quotation. An automated acknowledgement is not necessarily final acceptance if inventory, pricing, payment, or listing information is incorrect.

slots.slot_label: Terms of Use & Sale / Heading: Custom requests
Terms of Use & Sale / Text after Custom requests
slots.source_snapshot: Custom work may require a written scope, approved design, deposit, material confirmation, production estimate, and consent for any submitted media. Timelines are estimates and can change because of health, materials, equipment, weather, or other workshop conditions.

slots.slot_label: Terms of Use & Sale / Heading: Content and intellectual property
Terms of Use & Sale / Text after Content and intellectual property
slots.source_snapshot: Devil n Dove site text, original photographs, graphics, videos, designs, and branding remain protected by applicable rights unless stated otherwise. Customer-supplied material must be owned or properly licensed by the customer. Connecting a social account does not transfer ownership of platform content.

slots.slot_label: Terms of Use & Sale / Heading: Social publishing
Terms of Use & Sale / Text after Social publishing
slots.source_snapshot: Social integrations are intended for Devil n Dove-owned accounts. Draft automation does not guarantee publication. Administrators remain responsible for reviewing facts, media rights, privacy, platform rules, captions, links, and disclosures before any post is approved.

slots.slot_label: Terms of Use & Sale / Heading: Availability and limitations
Terms of Use & Sale / Text after Availability and limitations
slots.source_snapshot: The website and integrations are provided on an as-available basis. Third-party platforms can change permissions, pricing, limits, or APIs without notice. To the extent permitted by law, Devil n Dove is not responsible for indirect losses caused by outages, platform changes, unauthorized activity outside our reasonable control, or reliance on workshop/editorial information.

slots.slot_label: Data Deletion / Main heading: Data Deletion Instructions
Data Deletion / Text after Data Deletion Instructions
slots.source_snapshot: How to request deletion of eligible Devil n Dove account, media, and connected social-platform information.

slots.source_snapshot: Request deletion from Devil n Dove

slots.slot_label: Data Deletion / Text after Request deletion from Devil n Dove
slots.source_snapshot: We may ask for reasonable verification before deleting or releasing account information.

slots.slot_label: Data Deletion / Heading: Disconnect a social platform
Data Deletion / Text after Disconnect a social platform
slots.source_snapshot: Use the platform's own Apps and Websites or connected-app settings to revoke Devil n Dove access. Revocation stops future API access but may not delete posts already published. You may also ask us to remove stored connection tokens and identifiers.

slots.slot_label: Data Deletion / Heading: What may be retained
Data Deletion / Text after What may be retained
slots.source_snapshot: We may retain limited transaction, tax, fraud-prevention, security, audit, consent, dispute, or legal records when required or reasonably necessary. Where full deletion is not permitted, access can be restricted and the information minimized.

slots.slot_label: Data Deletion / Heading: Expected handling
